english.title: Contravene a requirement imposed by a health and safety information notice under s.27(1)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened a requirement imposed by a notice served under section 27(1) of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(i) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
